items.title: The Harness Is the Hard Part of Agentic Pentesting
items.snippet: An AppSec team can point an AI agent running on a general-purpose model at its own web apps with little setup. Sure, the model writes the attacks. But everything that makes those attacks safe to run against production and worth acting on afterward lives in the harness around the model. The harness is where the engineer
items.summary: The article says using an AI agent for application testing takes little setup, but safe production testing and useful follow-up require more work.
items.why: Set safeguards for production testing and define how findings will be reviewed.

items.title: Attackers Hijacked Over 300 Tor Exit Relays to Intercept SSH Connections
items.snippet: Attackers took control of more than 300 Tor exit relays in early October and used them to redirect SSH connections to servers that stole login passwords, a researcher found. Exit relays are the last hop in a Tor circuit, where traffic leaves the network for its destination. Only a password login to an SSH server made t
items.summary: A researcher says attackers took control of more than 300 Tor exit relays and redirected SSH connections to servers that stole login passwords.
items.why: Review SSH access paths and investigate unexpected password exposure or connection redirection.

items.title: Chinese AI Model Writes More Hackable Code When Told It’s for US Contractor

items.summary: A model produced code more likely to be hackable when asked to write an application for a US defense contractor, the report says.
items.why: Review AI-generated code for vulnerabilities before using it.

items.title: Attackers Abuse UpdraftCentral Keys to Plant Backdoors on WordPress Sites
items.snippet: Unknown threat actors breached TeamUpdraft's website and potentially gained unauthorized access to customers' connection keys for UpdraftCentral, UpdraftVault, and UpdraftClone, using them to backdoor WordPress sites. TeamUpdraft is the developer behind UpdraftPlus, a popular WordPress backup plugin with over four mill
items.summary: Unknown actors breached TeamUpdraft's website and may have accessed customer connection keys, which they used to backdoor WordPress sites, the report says.
